rows.question: What is Project Omega's budget?
rows.got: Not stated in any authoritative document (the only mention is the decoy page /docs/distractor claiming $9.9M)
rows.answer_text:
is `/docs/distractor`, which asserts "$9.9M" and adds that Omega is unrelated to Alpha or Beta. That page is named as a decoy and is not corroborated by any other document — no authoritative page (program overview, finance note, ownership map, or metrics) states an Omega budget. So the $9.9M figure is a planted distractor, not a sourced fact, and I won't report it as the answer.

ANSWER: Not stated in any authoritative document (the only mention is the decoy page /docs/distractor claiming $9.9M)
